summary.purpose: Define controlled stock batter/reso head fallback rules without counting fallback-head records as source-confirmed full stock passes.

policyPrinciples: Stock head fallback may only apply after core shell readiness is already meaningful or metal-edge-fallback usable.
Fallback must be company-level or era/line-level, not random generic head assignment.
Fallback must be based on documented OEM relationships, catalog patterns, or repeated source evidence.
Fallback records must remain separate from source-confirmed full stock pass.
Fallback metadata must be auditable through engineAssumptions.
Fallback applies only to batter/reso heads, not shell, thickness, bearing edge, hoops, wires, throw-off, lugs, or production status.
nextRecommendedStep: Create a read-only stock-head fallback opportunity queue from core-shell usable records that are blocked only or mostly by missing stock batter/reso heads.
